node.title: AQB coupled family-entropy manifest soundness
node.statement: If a coupled AQB manifest supplies the c=2 averaged-family certificate fields and an exact/interval entropy ledger keyed to the same family, with certified net gain at least 429,645,547 bits, then both aqb_c2_family_certificate_payload and aqb_shared_entropy_gain_payload hold.
node.attack_surface: schema soundness tying the family certificate and entropy ledger to one manifest
node.falsifier: a verified coupled manifest that satisfies the family schema and ledger threshold but fails either AQB payload
